newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Bashkortonstan republic mulls Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia Bashkortonstan republic mulls Eurobond issue.

text.p: Russia's autonomous republic of Bashkortostan is considering a Eurobond issue, Bashkortostan Economy Minister Valentin Vlasov said.

"We have a number of proposals from Moscow business structures and banks on entering the Eurobond market," he told a news conference. "The issue is under consideration. We understand perfectly well that the entrance to the Eurobond market means heavy liabilities. Any borrowing has to be repaid."
A number of Russian regions, including Nizhny Novgorod region, Tatarstan republic and Irkutsk region are planning Eurobond issues.
The Russian Federation made its debut $1 billion Eurobond last November. In March it placed its second Eurobond worth two billion marks. It is also planning a third issue soon.
